why.evolution and setup: The only real attacker is the Stage 2 Mega Blastoise ex (Squirtle to Wartortle to Mega Blastoise, no Rare Candy), and it needs 3 Water to attack and 6 for Bench damage.
why.Bench preparation: Wartortle's Shell Shield prevents all attack damage while benched, so the Water stack is built on the Bench behind a wall.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Eiscue (Ice Face) and Oricorio (Safeguard) are walls that soak hits and are often given up; Lucky Ice Pop, Soothing Shore, Lillie and Parasol Lady heal them or pick them back up.
why.control and combinations: Oricorio's Safeguard shuts out ex attackers, and Cyrus pulls up a Pokémon already damaged by Triple Bombardment's Bench hits to finish it.

why.evolution and setup: Same Squirtle to Wartortle to Mega Blastoise ex Stage 2 line with no Rare Candy; Misty can add Water to the line faster.
why.Bench preparation: Shell Shield Wartortle holds its Water safely on the Bench until it becomes the 6-Water Mega Blastoise ex.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Eiscue and Oricorio are walls that soak damage and are given up for time; Soothing Shore, Lucky Ice Pop, Lillie and Parasol Lady are the recovery.
why.control and combinations: Safeguard walls ex attackers, and Cyrus plus Triple Bombardment's Bench damage set up the knockouts.

why.evolution and setup: Two Stage 1 lines (Meowth to Persian, Type: Null to Silvally) must evolve before they attack; Silvally's Brave Buddies needs a Supporter played to reach 100.
why.Bench preparation: With three Energy types the Zone is random, so the Basic ex attackers (Terapagos ex with 3 Energy and +20 per type, Snorlax ex with 4) are charged on the Bench over several turns.

why.evolution and setup: Stoutland is a Stage 2 played through 2 Rare Candy from Lillipup, so the deck depends on finding Candy and Stoutland on time.
why.control and combinations: Guard Dog Visage makes the opponent's attacks cost 1 more and Cheren gives -100 against ex; the Psychic Supporter moves Energy onto the opposing Active to power up Indeedee ex's Psychic attack, and Field Blower removes Tools or the Stadium.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Indeedee ex's Watch Over and Lillie keep healing the Active Stoutland, and Protective Poncho protects a benched Indeedee.
